note: Glasses recordings shown on the Emotiv station page. `file` is the web copy under clips/, `trace` the replay under traces/. A clip with `pending` has no replay yet and says why. A clip with `script` is kept as a fixed example of the panel: the order and time each connector goes in were set by hand from the recording, and the panel is drawn from that. A clip with `labels` has a box for each opening on the frames where the row is in clear view, checked by eye; the page draws those on the frame the count read.
